races.display_title: 200,000 Pound Tattersalls October Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This looks a good chance for NIGHT IN VEGAS to land a third valuable pot in a row. Zigazig Ah chased him home in a similar race on the July Course here at the end of the summer and can give him most to think about again. Woodhay Wayfarer has a steadily progressive profile and may prove best of the remainder. NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE) ZIGAZIG AH WOODHAY WAYFARER (IRE)

races.display_title: BetMGM Sun Chariot Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Group 1)
races.verdict: BLUE BOLT can't be opposed as she bids for a fourth successive Group 1 win. City of Memphis followed her home in the Matron and may do so again. races.display_title: HKJC World Pool Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: EVANESCO has developed into a smart handicapper and can resume winning ways on the back of a cracking run in Ireland. The main danger could be Old Newton Cup winner Sportingsilvermine , who's enjoyed a largely stellar season for the excellent James Owen team, with Primo Lara also respected in his current vein of form. EVANESCO SPORTINGSILVERMINE (IRE) PRIMO LARA (IRE)

races.display_title: William Hill Two Year Old Trophy (Listed)
races.verdict: SATELLITE OF LOVE and Revels stand out on form here and Clive Cox's Minzaal colt edges the vote on the back of a fine clear second in a valuable sales event at Doncaster over Karl Burke's Mill Reef fourth. Both Thames Waterman and Myesme are less exposed and arrive on the back of impressive wins at Wolverhampton and Beverley respectively so shouldn't be underestimated in a cracking renewal of the Two-Year-Old Trophy. SATELLITE OF LOVE (IRE) REVELS THAMES WATERMAN

races.verdict: None can be dismissed in a cracking listed event but Ralph Beckett's low-mileage 5-y-o VALVANO impressed when returning from an absence to score at Southwell (form been well advertised) and he gets the vote with better still likely to come. races.display_title: BetMGM British EBF October Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict: SO REGAL has quickly progressed into a useful filly, shaping encouragingly after 4 months off when not beaten far in a Group 3 at Sandown in August. She represents last year's winning stable/owners (Cheveley Park also landed the prize in 2024) and can gain a first black-type success, at the expense of last year's runner-up Dash of Azure . Midnight Tango completes the shortlist. SO REGAL DASH OF AZURE MIDNIGHT TANGO
races.betting_forecast: So Regal (1/1), Dash Of Azure (15/2), Midnight Tango (8/1), Breckenbrough (8/1), Albaydaa (10/1), Awaken (16/1), Domina Ignis (16/1), Just A Girl (16/1), American Gal (25/1), Josh's Joy (25/1), Secret History (33/1), Mostar Dreams (33/1)

races.verdict: TUCO SALAMANCA sets a clear standard on his first foray into listed company following another personal best from a lofty handicap rating when second in the Ayr Gold Cup a fortnight ago. races.verdict: DIVISION has raised his game appreciably this year, shaping well when just touched off in the Prix Maurice de Gheest at Deauville on his most recent outing and earns the vote to register a deserved success back down in grade. races.verdict: MAELSTROM got back on the up for current connections with wins at Newmarket and this C&D in August/September, so he's well worth another chance having had excuses at Doncaster last time. He gets the vote ahead of Gold Star Hero , who was denied late on by the selection here last month, with Adrestia also considered on the back of her latest effort. races.display_title: Finbarr OSullivan 21st Carpe Diem Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Irish raider EBEN ZAABEEL has seemingly benefited from the application of a tongue strap in recent starts, travelling best from some way out when making his second hurdles start a winning one at Downpatrick 33 days ago. He does need to brush up on his jumping but can do better still if doing so and earns the vote to follow up under Sean Bowen. Down To Business back down in trip rates next best. Anniversary and Aquaman are hurdles newcomers to note. EBEN ZAABEEL DOWN TO BUSINESS ANNIVERSARY

He is taken to make the breakthrough in first-time cheekpieces. Imperial Ballet looked potentially useful when winning on debut last August and rates the chief danger, though she may need this return. All You Can Be shaped with promise despite greenness on debut and can improve in a first-time hood. CLOUD FOREST IMPERIAL BALLET ALL YOU CAN BE (USA)

races.display_title: Gowran Park Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict: EL CAIROS , a promising novice hurdler last season, probably did well to finish as close as he did having been tight for room on more than one occasion during the latter stages in the Galway Hurdle in July and makes most appeal on these terms. Gaucher has to concede weight all round but arrives fit and in good form from the Flat, so is much respected, while Ebony King is also of interest back in this sphere having showed marked improvement when scoring on the level at Listowel last week. EL CAIROS (FR) GAUCHER EBONY KING (IRE)

races.display_title: Like A Butterfly Novice Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict: A few of these bring potential but Willie Mullins has a fine record in this and his VICAR STREET is fancied to take another step forward and follow up his commanding Galway victory (form worked out well) after a break. Frankie John rates a good prospect too though, and seems sure to go close, while the likeable Shadow Paddy shouldn't be underestimated either in his bid to go 4-4 in this sphere. VICAR STREET (IRE) FRANKIE JOHN (IRE) SHADOW PADDY (IRE)

races.verdict: KILLEEMORE LAD wasn’t winning out of turn at Downpatrick in August and is taken to follow up now sent handicapping in this sphere from what looks a very fair opening mark. Recent winner Luimneach arrives on the back of a good second at Wexford and rates the main danger, while Its Bilbo has been running well over hurdles and makes his handicap chase debut off his last winning hurdles mark.
